title: How to Build a Video Sharing Platform with AI (No Code)
summary: Build a video sharing platform with AI — course creator or team video library. Storage, auth, and database included. No S3 or CDN config needed to start.
body_markdown: Teachable starts at $39/month plus 5% transaction fees; Kajabi starts at $149/month. A custom Blink-built platform has zero per-seat fees and zero transaction fees — you keep all revenue. The tradeoff: you handle your own maintenance and don't get Teachable or Kajabi's built-in affiliate marketing tools or course marketplace distribution. For creators who want full control and margin, building your own wins.
